excerpt.zh: 是的！我们获胜了，我们是胜利者！如果你嫌自家的生命、钢铁和宝石太多的话，大可再来挑衅我们！
excerpt.en: Yes! We are victorious, we overcome! Come to us again, if your metal and gems and lives are too many!

texts.zh: 是的！我们获胜了，我们是胜利者！如果你嫌自家的生命、钢铁和宝石太多的话，大可再来挑衅我们！
texts.en: Yes! We are victorious, we overcome! Come to us again, if your metal and gems and lives are too many!

texts.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，目前的战势对你方有利。但只有在和平之下我们才能繁荣发展。
texts.en: The numbers speak in your favor, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. In peace there is prosperity.

texts.zh: 我们按照[This.GetSpeciesAdj]的传统光明正大地战胜了你们。制定条约是我们的特权与职责。
texts.en: We have defeated you in noble combat as per the [This.GetSpeciesAdj] traditions. We have the privilege and obligation to dictate the terms.

texts.zh: 你们讨价还价的本领很厉害，但最终还是我们技高一筹。不要低估资金雄厚的军团在市场中的价值。
texts.en: You drove a hard bargain, but we outbid you in the end. Don't underestimate the strength of a well-funded army in an unregulated market.

texts.zh: 我们终于可以将这次冲突抛到脑后了。希望这让你们明白了战争的代价。
texts.en: Finally, we can put this conflict behind us. We hope this has taught you the cost of war.

texts.zh: 最终，脆弱的[Root.GetName]被迫就范。这只是我们争夺星系主导地位的又一块垫脚石。
texts.en: At last the frail [Root.GetName] has been brought to heel. Just another stepping stone on our road to galactic supremacy.

texts.zh: 我们双方都为这场战争付出了高昂的代价，但希望你们明白不要再招惹[This.GetName]或其盟友了。
texts.en: We have both paid a high price for this war, but hopefully you will have learned not to threaten the [This.GetName] or its allies.

texts.zh: 我们已经除掉了[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的威胁！我们的边境重归安宁，[This.GetSpeciesAdj]的未来又一次得以保障。
texts.en: We have driven out the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] menace! Our borders and the [This.GetSpeciesAdj] future are once again secure.

texts.zh: 从你们的角度来说，这场战争完全是徒劳的。任凭谁都无法抵御[This.GetName]的扩张。
texts.en: This war was always a futile effort on your behalf. None can stand against the expansion of the [This.GetName].

texts.zh: 我们提出的要求已经很仁慈了，你们不应该对[This.GetSpeciesAdj]怀恨在心。
texts.en: We have been lenient in our demands only so that you may not carry resentment against the [This.GetSpeciesAdj] people in your hearts.

texts.zh: 异教徒，跪下！你们发动了预言中的战争，并为你们的愚蠢付出了代价。
texts.en: Kneel, heathen! You have done battle with the heralds of divine providence and paid the price for your foolishness.

texts.zh: 不要以为这样就结束了。只要星系中还存在着[Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]，就不可能有真正的和平。
texts.en: Do not think this is the end. As long as there are [Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult] in the galaxy, there can be no true peace.

texts.zh: 为了解放[Root.GetAdj]的人民，我们采取了必要的措施。不要再妨碍我们正义的事业了。
texts.en: We have taken the necessary steps to bring freedom to the [Root.GetAdj] people. Don't stand in the way of our noble cause again.

texts.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]，你应该清楚自己的位置。你们注定要服侍我们，而不是与我们作对。
texts.en: You should have known your place, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]. Your people were meant to serve us, not to fight us.

texts.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult]，现在你后悔妨碍[This.GetName]了吗？我们对挑战我们的统治的敌人绝不手软。
texts.en: Do you regret interfering with the [This.GetName] now, [Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult]? We are not lenient with those who upset our rule.

texts.zh: 今天，理智战胜了愚昧。继续在黑暗中跌跌撞撞吧，你们还将被开化的民族击败更多次。
texts.en: Today, reason triumphs over ignorance. Continue to stumble around in the dark, and you will suffer more defeats against enlightened people.

texts.zh: 通过这场胜利，我们成功了守护和平与和谐。我们不指望你能理解。
texts.en: Through this victory, we have sought to restore balance and harmony. We wouldn't expect you to understand.

texts.zh: [This.GetAdj]人民欢庆今天的胜利。我们和平的社会绝不会再次受到[Root.GetName]阴谋诡计的威胁。
texts.en: The [This.GetAdj] people rejoice on this day of victory. Never again shall our peaceful society be threatened by the malicious plans of the [Root.GetName].

texts.zh: 今天，[Root.GetAdj]不敬者受到了正义的制裁。我们神圣的任务得以履行。
texts.en: Justice has been delivered upon the [Root.GetAdj] desecrators on this day. Our hallowed duties have been fulfilled.

texts.zh: 心存侥幸吧。败在我们手里总好过在死亡的路上一去不复返。
texts.en: Consider yourselves fortunate. Defeat at our hands is vastly preferable to continuing down the path to destruction.

texts.zh: 正如你们早就明白飞船不要离闪耀的恒星太近，现在你们明白了不要惹[This.GetName]。
texts.en: Just as you learned not to fly your ships too close to a brightly burning star, you have now learned not to disturb the [This.GetName].

texts.zh: 虽然挑选与消灭部分人口花费了一些精力，不过[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的人口暂时不会在对星系的生态系统产生不良影响了。
texts.en: It took some prudent culling, but the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] population should not threaten the galactic ecosystem for a while now.

texts.zh: 惩罚进程完成。自卫协议终止。处罚协议启动。
texts.en: Punishment process complete. Self-defense protocols ended. Punitive protocols initiated.

texts.zh: 今天，[Root.GetAdj]不敬者受到了正义的制裁。我们神圣的任务得以履行。

texts.zh: 摧毁。
texts.en: Demolish.

texts.zh: 我们只需派出一个就足以击败你们零散的抵抗。别再试探我们了。
texts.en: It would only have taken one of us to defeat your splintered resistance. Do not test us again.

texts.zh: 够了，你们还未领悟战争的真谛。拿着这些资源，下次再好好打一场。
texts.en: That is enough, you have yet to learn the true meaning of War. Take these resources and put up a better fight next time.

texts.zh: 听好了，晚辈。我们回来可不是为了容忍这种愚蠢行为。
texts.en: Now listen to your elders. We did not return to suffer this foolishness.

texts.zh: 给工蜂更多资源。给星球更多资源。更多。更多。更多。更——
texts.en: More material for the drones. More material for the worlds. More. More. More. Mo-

texts.zh: 战争结束了。我方大获全胜！
texts.en: This war is over. We are victorious.
